contexts.text: If they had acknowledged the Lord to be one with the Father... no one could have been recognised as His vicar... AE 528, Explained.
Such believe that there must be some one as the Lord's vicar on earth...
By the hand of anyone = vicarious power, which is the same as mediately...
The life's love... places a vicar below itself, which is called the love of the means. DP 109:2. DP 110:end.
(The Papists) acknowledge the Word for the sake of the vicarship established on the Lord's words to Peter.
That the vicarship is an invention...
A deputy substituted in the place (of Mohammed).
To adore any vicar upon earth... avails (nothing) in Heaven.
If the Pontiff were called the Supreme, and not the vicar, they would lose everything.
They had believed that they were His vicars.
Thou shalt not worship other gods, involves that... no vicar of the Lord is to be worshipped as Divine.
The internal adoration (the Papists) have transferred to the Pope as the vicar, and from him to the ministering body as vicars under him.

Within Babylon are those in France, and many in Holland, England, Scotland, and Ireland, who have not taken away from the Lord the Power of saving men, nor the Divine holiness from the Word, and ascribed these to some vicar...
They call their chief Pontiff the successor of Peter, and thus the vicar of the Lord...
Thus transferring their love to the Lord [to the Pope] as a vicar, and to his ministers.
They have no truths from the Word, thus not from the Lord; but only from him whom they call His vicar...
He said that the Lord alone is to be honoured and worshipped... intending to become His vicar...
